purpose: Reject volatility-magnitude, directional-semivariance, and concentration-statistic variants before values and select one economically distinct scale-free price-discovery dispersion mechanism for the next ordered no-return audit.

closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_realized_volatility: Total squared-return magnitude; it is scale-sensitive and does not describe how that variance is distributed across the session's valid minute returns.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_volatility_resolution_238m: Morning-versus-afternoon allocation of squared returns; it collapses each half to one sum rather than measuring within-session dispersion over all return observations.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_diffusive_variation_ratio_238m: Adjacent bipower variation divided by realized variance; it measures local path continuity, not the Shannon dispersion of individual squared-return contributions.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_amount_participation_entropy_24: Shannon dispersion of CNY traded amount across bars; it is price-free and its probability mass comes from amount rather than squared returns.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_upside_semivariance_share_239m: Directional share of squared variation; it distinguishes positive from negative moves instead of measuring direction-blind variance dispersion.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_amount_volatility_coupling_238p: Cross-minute correlation between amount and absolute return magnitude; it requires amount and does not measure the marginal distribution of variance contributions.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: intraday_return_variance_concentration_hhi_or_max_share
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Herfindahl concentration or maximum squared-return share across the same 238 returns
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: These are alternative concentration transforms of the same frozen variance-distribution mechanism and would create post-result statistic search.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: intraday_absolute_return_entropy
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Shannon entropy of absolute-return shares instead of squared-return shares
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Changing the contribution power is a same-mechanism transform search; squared returns are selected because they exactly partition realized variance.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: signed_upside_or_downside_variance_entropy
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Separate entropy for positive or negative returns or combine their difference
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Direction splitting overlaps the terminal upside-semivariance and sign-composition mechanisms.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: morning_afternoon_or_late_variance_entropy
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Compute entropy separately on a selected intraday window
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Window selection overlaps the terminal volatility-resolution mechanism and invites time-window search.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_return_variance_entropy_238m
selected_candidate.formula: -sum(q_j * log(q_j)) / log(238), where q_j = r_j^2 / sum(r_k^2) across the 238 within-half adjacent minute log returns and zero q contributes zero
selected_candidate.return_grid: Use 119 adjacent returns inside 09:31-11:30 and 119 inside 13:01-15:00. Exclude the standalone 09:30 row and the 11:30-to-13:01 cross-lunch transition.
selected_candidate.mechanism: Variance entropy measures whether close-known intraday price discovery was distributed continuously across many observations instead of being dominated by one or a few isolated jumps.
selected_candidate.hypothesis: A high close-known entropy value indicates broad, repeated information assimilation rather than a fragile single-bar shock, which may be more likely to persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.economic_distinction: It is direction-blind, amount-free, and invariant to multiplying every within-day return by a common scale. It measures the distributional breadth of realized-variance contributions, not total volatility, half-day allocation, adjacent-return continuity, return sign, amount distribution, or amount-return dependence.
